conflicts.where: Lesson 4 vs Lesson 1/2 (phloem location) and Lesson 7 description 'EXPLAIN lesson in the 8-lesson sequence'
conflicts.problem: Lesson 4 says the red rings are xylem and the 'colourless outer tissue of the vascular bundle is phloem'. Lesson 1 says the outer green tissue stayed white and the dye appeared in dot-shaped regions, so the phloem location is inconsistent. Lesson 3 also says the root pressure explains the dye movement while Lesson 7 says transpiration pull is the primary force, so the lessons disagree on the cause of the upward movement.

conflicts.where: Lessons 1 and 5 vs Lesson 6 (Group C 'sealed bag' and Group data)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 6 reports the results as qualitative only (no numbers), yet the Final Explanation asks learners to use class results that were recorded and graphed. Lesson 5 also uses a sealed polythene bag for Group C, which is inconsistent with measuring water loss from the beaker volume, since the bag traps vapour.
